moments.title: Championship Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The English Football League Championship season begins today, with a host of exciting fixtures across the country.

angles.name: Matchday Excitement
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Championship is back today with Bolton v Preston, Stoke v Swansea and more. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Local Teams in Action
angles.copy: The Championship kicks off today! Keep an eye on local teams like Stoke and Swansea as they start their campaigns. Big season ahead!

moments.title: Jimmy Eat World at Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: US rock legends Jimmy Eat World play a sold-out show at Cardiff Castle today, celebrating 25 years of their iconic album 'Bleed American' with support from Rise Against.

angles.name: Cardiff Rock Out
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is SOLD OUT for Jimmy Eat World tonight! Celebrating 25 years of 'Bleed American' – who's ready to sing along to every word?

angles.name: Bleed American Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years of 'Bleed American'! Jimmy Eat World are bringing the anniversary party to Cardiff Castle today. What's your favourite track from the album?

moments.title: Joe Jonas Turns 37
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Joe Jonas, known for Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joe
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many bangers. What's your favourite Joe track?

angles.name: Jonas Brothers Flashback
angles.copy: It's Joe Jonas's 37th birthday! Time to blast some Jonas Brothers or DNCE to celebrate. Which era of Joe's music is your favourite?

moments.title: Milford Waterfront Weekender Concludes
moments.blurb: The Milford Waterfront Weekender, featuring street food and live music from Pembrokeshire and South West Wales, wraps up tomorrow after three days of festivities.

angles.name: Last Chance Milford
angles.copy: Last chance to soak up the atmosphere at Milford Waterfront Weekender! Head down today or tomorrow for live music and incredible street food. Don't miss out!

angles.name: Pembrokeshire Flavours
angles.copy: The Milford Waterfront Weekender is bringing the best of Pembrokeshire's food and music to Mackerel Quay. Catch the final day tomorrow!

moments.title: HAAS Live in Exeter
moments.blurb: HAAS performs live at The Word Barn Meadow in Exeter today, offering local music fans a chance to catch the act.

angles.name: Exeter Live Music
angles.copy: Tonight in Exeter! HAAS takes the stage at The Word Barn Meadow. Grab your tickets and support live local music!

angles.name: Weekend Warm-Up
angles.copy: Kicking off the weekend with live music in Exeter! HAAS is at The Word Barn Meadow tonight. Who's heading out?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing, transforming Scotland's capital with thousands of shows across various genres until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is hitting its stride, with incredible theatre, comedy, music and more. What hidden gems have you discovered?

angles.name: Arts Takeover
angles.copy: From stand-up to street performers, the Edinburgh Fringe Festival continues to deliver an explosion of creative energy. There's still plenty of time to catch a show!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Countdown
moments.blurb: The UK's iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals are just under two weeks away, running from August 27-30 with headliners including Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: The countdown is ON for Reading & Leeds! Who are you most excited to see? Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine – it's going to be massive!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Banger
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just around the corner, bringing the August Bank Holiday weekend to life with the biggest names in music. Get ready!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's largest electronic music festivals, is set to electrify Daresbury from August 27-30, featuring top DJs like Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Tiësto.

angles.name: Dance Nation Unite
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is almost here! Get ready for four days of non-stop beats with Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Tiësto and more. Who's heading to Daresbury?

angles.name: Electronic Extravaganza
angles.copy: From house to techno, Creamfields is the ultimate August Bank Holiday party. The lineup is stacked – which sets are you buzzing for?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Next Week
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz, soul, hip hop, and electronic music, takes place in Dorset from August 20-23.

angles.name: Dorset Grooves
angles.copy: Next week, We Out Here Festival brings a world of jazz, soul, hip hop and electronica to Dorset! Curated by Gilles Peterson, it's a must for music lovers.

angles.name: Beyond the Mainstream
angles.copy: Looking for something different? We Out Here Festival kicks off next Thursday, promising four days of incredible genre-hopping music. Who's joining the party?

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle Turns 68
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, celebrates her 68th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is a Birthday
angles.copy: On Monday, Belinda Carlisle turns 68! Get ready to sing along to 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' and 'Our Lips Are Sealed'. What's your favourite Belinda track?

angles.name: Go-Go's Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle on Monday! A true icon of the 80s.

moments.title: Donnie Wahlberg Turns 57
moments.blurb: Donnie Wahlberg, member of New Kids on the Block and actor, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to New Kids on the Block's Donnie Wahlberg on Monday! What's your favourite NKOTB hit to get you dancing?

angles.name: From Pop to Police
angles.copy: Actor and New Kids on the Block star Donnie Wahlberg turns 57 on Monday! Celebrate with a throwback to his biggest hits.

moments.title: Phoebe Bridgers Turns 31
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers celebrates her 31st birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Monday marks Phoebe Bridgers' 31st birthday! Her poetic lyrics and unique sound have captured so many. What's your favourite Phoebe track?

angles.name: Songwriter Spotlight
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the brilliant Phoebe Bridgers on Monday! Dive into her discography this weekend.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Anticipation
moments.blurb: The UK's final Bank Holiday until Christmas falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer and a busy period for festivals and events.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Buzz
angles.copy: Just over two weeks until the August Bank Holiday! Are you planning a festival, a staycation or a chill-out at home?

angles.name: End of Summer Plans
angles.copy: The last Bank Holiday until Christmas is coming up on August 31st! What are your plans to make the most of the final summer long weekend?

moments.title: Amplitude Festival in Swansea
moments.blurb: Swansea Amphitheatre hosts the free Amplitude festival on August 22-23, celebrating the area's thriving grassroots music scene with diverse genres.

source.l: Events and festivals in Wales during August

angles.name: Swansea's Free Festival
angles.copy: Next weekend, Amplitude Festival lights up Swansea Amphitheatre with a FREE celebration of local grassroots music! Who's ready for some new sounds?

angles.name: Support Local Talent
angles.copy: Get ready for two days of incredible live music at Swansea's Amplitude Festival on August 22-23. A fantastic showcase of local artists!
